dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello. Because here we have a problem.
Ok, please tell me what happened?
Because there is the man on the rod impaled.
Excuse me, what do you mean sir?
Man on a... a rod. He hit the rod and is stabbed on rod.
(foreign language)
{ADDRESS?} Where are you calling from sir?
We are in this broken building.
{WHERE EXACTLY?} Where is it exactly?
Old factory at [[ADDRESS]]
Old factory at Pine Street
Old factory at 5 avenue
Old factory at Oak Street
{IS HE CONSCIOUS?} Is he conscious?
I think he is... I mean I do not know... well, he's heavy breathing.
{IS HE MOVING?} Ok, Is he moving?
He moves a little... with legs and hands on the sides ...
(foreign language)
{IS HE BLEEDING?} Listen, is he bleeding?
No no... he is stuck on the rod. Rod is strong and he's on this rod. We can not move him.
{HE CAN'T MOVE?}So the victim can't move?
Yes, he can't move. We can lift him with Janusz and help him. (foreign language)
{DON'T MOVE HIM} No, no don't move him! You can make his injuries worse. As long as he's breathing, he is ok. Just wait for the ambulance to get there.
So we can go, right?
{WAIT} Please wait for the ambulance to get there and if his condition gets worst I want you to call 911 again.
Ok, ok.
{PICK HIM UP} Please try to pick him up.
(foreign language)
(foreign language)
Ok, Ok!........ We took him off but there is big blood.
{STOP THE BLEEDING} Do you have something that you can use to stop the bleeding?
I don't know. No I don't... just my jacket.
{PUT IT ON THE WOUND} Please try to put something on the wound and apply pressure so you can stop the bleeding!
. . . . . . . . . . We need ambulance here!
{HELP IS COMING}Ambulance is on the way.
{YOU CAN GO} Yes, you can go. Ambulance is on its way.
So we go . . . . (foreign language)
{SEND SOMEONE TO THE ROAD} Stay with the injured man. Send your friend to the road and he can guide the ambulance to your location.
Alright . . . . . (foreign language)
{STOP THE BLEEDING} Please I want you to stop the bleeding so his condition doesn't get worst. And then please call again if it does.
Ok, ok.
Anyone there?

reportElement.texten: A man has impaled himself on a rod.
The operator instructed the caller to move the injured man, which caused serious internal damages in his body.
The operator provided proper instruction to stop the bleeding.
The operator let to leave the injured man alone.
The ambulance lost some time on searching the place of the incident, because of imprecise address.
One of the men guided the ambulance to the place of the incident. Thanks to that, paramedics could provide medical help sooner.
